review_candidates.title: Information Technology System Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Available vacancy in our Vilnius office: IT System Administrator We are looking for an experienced IT System Administrator to maintain and continuously improve our IT infrastructure across multiple locations. Responsibilities: Manage Windows/Linux servers, virtual and cloud infrastructure across multiple company locations. Maintain network infrastructure, identity and access management . Maintain documentation, IT assets and software licences. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in system admin
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements: 3+ years of experience in system administration of Windows Server and Linux environments; Hands-on experience with virtualization (hypervisors) and on-premise/cloud infrastructure; Solid knowledge of directory and identity services: user accounts, groups, group policies, MFA and privileged access; Good understanding of network infrastructure: LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPN, Wi-Fi and site-to-site connections; Experience with patch management, backup and restore solutions, and system monitoring tools. Nice-to-Have Knowledge of NIS2 and ISO 27001 requirements and practical implementation of technical security controls; Experience with endpoint protection, logging and hardening baselines/secure configuration; Experience with Jira or other ITSM tools; scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash).
